ICS 59.080TXD 36Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard covers the requirements for reusable (multiple use) sanitary pad/sanitary napkin/period panties for external use.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards
